mode.title: Mode
mode.description: cert = the graded item, its population, PSA's price estimate and a sales summary, one row per certification number. sales = every comparable sale PSA lists for that certificate, one row each. range = walk a block of consecutive certification numbers. reference = check the source is answering right now.
enumTitles: range - a block of consecutive cert numbers
reference - is the source answering right now

certNumber.title: Certification number
certNumber.description: A single PSA certification number, the number printed on the label. A full psacard.com/cert/... URL works too.

certNumbers.title: Certification numbers
certNumbers.description: Several certification numbers to look up in one run.

startCert.title: Start certification number (range mode)
startCert.description: First certification number of the block to walk. Certificates are issued sequentially, so a block covers cards graded around the same time.

rangeCount.title: How many (range mode)
rangeCount.description: How many consecutive certification numbers to look up, starting at 'startCert'. Capped at 5000.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many certificates to look up in parallel. Keep this modest - the source is behind a strict gate and hammering it invites a block.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is REQUIRED and is the default. PSA refuses datacenter IP addresses outright: the same lookup that works from a home connection returns nothing from a cloud one. Leave this as it is unless you are supplying your own residential proxy.
